body.name: Exact-active finite SCM realizations of the common law
body.construction: For \(j\in\{1,2\}\), construct \(M_{j\star}\) in the displayed topological order of \(G_{j\star}\) by assigning one independent finite uniform exogenous variable to each observed vertex and using the inverse-CDF response table from the corresponding conditional probability in \(p_{\star}\). For \(M_{1\star}\), use uniform support sizes \(2,4,8,5\) for the response tables of \(c,a,b,d\). For \(M_{2\star}\), use uniform support sizes \(2,80,1159,26\) for the response tables of \(d,a,b,c\). Set a binary child to one exactly on the initial segment whose size equals its displayed success probability times the relevant support size.
